description:
investigate and decompose gap route-edit-62647d4c: In repos/activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts, remove a duplicate route registration. The path GET /conservation-audit is registered TWICE with byte-identical handler bodies; the framework serves the first, so the second is unreachable dead code and its duplicated anchors make the endpoint impossible to edit surgically.

DELETE THE SECOND REGISTRATION ONLY. Keep the first one exactly as it is.
